Privacy Policy

Last updated: 19 May 2026 · Effective immediately

Short version: ISMR does not sell your data, does not run advertising, and does not require an account. We collect anonymous usage analytics via Google Analytics 4 with IP anonymisation enabled. That's it.

Contents

  1. Who we are
  2. Data we collect
  3. Analytics (Google Analytics 4)

1. Who we are

ISMR (Interactive Scooter Manuals for Repair) is a free, open-content website at ismr.online. It is operated by an individual hobbyist based in the Netherlands. Contact: dexa88@gmail.com.

For the purposes of EU data protection law (GDPR), the individual is the data controller.

2. Data we collect

Data you provide voluntarily

ISMR currently has no user accounts, comment systems, or contact forms. If you email us directly, we will receive your email address and the contents of your message. We use that information only to reply to you, and we do not add it to any mailing list without your explicit consent.

Data collected automatically

When you visit ismr.online, our web server and analytics service may automatically collect:

  • Pages visited and time spent on each page
  • Referring website (how you found us)
  • Browser type and operating system
  • Device type (desktop, tablet, mobile)
  • Approximate geographic region (country/city — derived from a truncated IP address)

We do not collect your full IP address, name, or any directly identifying information.

3. Analytics — Google Analytics 4

We use Google Analytics 4 (GA4) to understand how visitors use the site — which guides are most read, where traffic comes from, and which pages need improvement. This helps us prioritise content.

GA4 is configured with IP anonymisation enabled (anonymize_ip: true), meaning your full IP address is never stored by Google.

Google Analytics data is processed by Google LLC, 1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA 94043, USA. Google acts as a data processor on our behalf under a Data Processing Agreement. Data may be transferred to the United States under the EU–US Data Privacy Framework.

You can opt out of Google Analytics tracking at any time using the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on.

The legal basis for this processing is our legitimate interest (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR) in understanding site usage to improve the service. Analytics data is aggregated and cannot be used to identify you individually.

4. Cookies

ISMR uses only the cookies set by Google Analytics. These are first-party cookies (stored under the ismr.online domain) that persist for up to 2 years. They store an anonymous client identifier so GA4 can distinguish returning visitors from new ones.

We do not use advertising cookies, social-media tracking cookies, or any other persistent cookies beyond those required for analytics.

You can delete or block cookies at any time through your browser settings. Blocking analytics cookies will not affect your ability to read any content on this site.

5. Your rights under GDPR

If you are located in the European Economic Area (EEA) or United Kingdom, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:

  • Right of access — you can request a copy of any personal data we hold about you.
  • Right to rectification — you can ask us to correct inaccurate data.
  • Right to erasure — you can ask us to delete your data ("right to be forgotten").
  • Right to restrict processing — you can ask us to limit how we use your data.
  • Right to object — you can object to processing based on legitimate interests (including analytics).
  • Right to data portability — you can request your data in a machine-readable format.
  • Right to withdraw consent — where processing is based on consent, you can withdraw it at any time without affecting lawfulness of prior processing.

To exercise any of these rights, email dexa88@gmail.com. We will respond within 30 days. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your national data protection authority (in Belgium: Gegevensbeschermingsautoriteit / APD).

6. Data retention

Google Analytics data is retained for 14 months (the minimum configurable period) and then automatically deleted. Email correspondence is retained for as long as reasonably necessary to resolve the matter, and deleted on request.

7. Third-party services

ISMR embeds videos from YouTube using the privacy-enhanced youtube-nocookie.com domain, which means YouTube does not set tracking cookies until you actually play a video. Once you press play, YouTube's own privacy policy applies.

The site is hosted on a Hetzner server in Germany (EU). Hetzner processes access logs (IP addresses, request paths) in accordance with their privacy policy. Access logs are retained for 7 days.

We do not use any advertising networks, affiliate tracking scripts, or social-media share buttons that track you across sites.

8. Children

ISMR is a technical reference site intended for adults. We do not knowingly collect personal data from anyone under 16. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us and we will delete it promptly.

9. Changes to this policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we will update the "Last updated" date at the top of this page. Material changes (for example, adding new data processors) will be noted in the site's news section. Continued use of ISMR after a policy update constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.

10. Contact

For any privacy-related questions or requests:

  • Email: dexa88@gmail.com
  • Response time: within 30 days for GDPR requests, usually much sooner for general questions
